verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Superhuman Mail MCP server that connects the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants for summarizing threads, drafting and sending emails, and scheduling meetings across multiple Gmail and Outlook accounts. Sends require explicit user approval, and a probe confirmed the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and technical setup detail (endpoint/auth flow, exposed tool list).
